notes.title: Tower Princess Update 1.04 - New Feature!!!
notes.content:
[h1]New Community Feature[/h1]
Greetings fellow knights!

Our community has asked to keep the princess you've chosen to rescue once you defeat together the Evil Dragon, so...

We've heard you! Before, once you've beaten the game with a princess, you could only find her crown at her regular spot at the Entry Hall, as she has already been rescued. Now she's back with the crown over her head, so you can storm the dungeon together, AGAIN!

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Once you've beaten the game with a princess or prince they no longer disappear
[*] Fixed small issue with Sunder special ability
[*] Fixed Kobold bards endlessly buffing themselves
[*] Minor lighting and collision fixes

[/list]
+ Some bug fixes
+ Minor improvements


If you like it, you can consider leaving a positive review on Steam, adding your suggestions or feedback for next updates, thanks a lot!

notes.title: COMMUNITY FEEDBACK!
notes.content:
Hey friendly folks!

Before anything else, thank you so much to all those knights who entered the dungeon at the Knight's Trial! It's been really heartwarming to receive so much support from the community, but even most importantly, we've received lots of feedback too!

So we've heard that feedback, and implemented as much as we could in the game!

MAJOR CHANGES
ːsteamthisː We've added difficulty levels! Easy mode will be perfect for those who just want to enjoy a casual experience in the dungeon, and know the princesses! Medium is thought for those that want a challenging experience but haven't played before, or that don't have experience with platformers or roguelites. And Hard mode is intended for experienced players that look for a true challenge, as the game was originally meant to be!

ːsteamthisː Right now the gameplay of the knights should feel much more swift, with faster transitions between animations and an increased responsivity from the player input!

ːsteamthisː Keybinding! If you didn't find the default set of controls comfortable, now you can make your own from the Options menu!

ːsteamthisː You can change between princesses at the Entry Hall. You didn't feel ready to rescue a certain princess? Don't worry, ask out another one to enter the dungeon!


MINOR CHANGES
- Now jumps interrupt basic attacks!
- Increased the length of some princesses' power
- Nerfed the Mimic Crab's damage
- Given a different colour for each princess crown in the HUD
- Given more space between princess and knight
- Fixed some issues when using the Kobold power during the tutorial
- Added options for motion blur and FPS settings
- Each boss specific mechanic changes according to the difficulty level!
- And many details more!


If you already played Tower Princess alpha or beta, and felt it needed any of these things, we're waiting for your feedback to keep improving the game! It's really great to be able to push Tower Princess even further thanks to the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/1bf577ff651d65f8af647cf70395d8405ad957f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Tower Princess: Knight's Trial
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow knights![/h3]

[h1]Tower Princess: Knight's Trial[/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to announce that in a few weeks we’re going to release a free and very new demo of Tower Princess, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1788110/Tower_Princess_Knights_Trial/]Tower Princess: Knight’s Trial[/url][/b]! The demo ver. includes three new princesses to rescue, dozens of rooms with traps and enemies, and a boss fight!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1788110/Tower_Princess_Knights_Trial/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/a1784452e58fdfd5f8a7489797b39cd4a6a10cb1.png[/img][/url]

Apart from new content, the demo has the updated HUD, new UI, bug fixes, balance improvements and much more. Add Tower Princess: Knight's Trial to your wishlist to make sure you won’t miss the release![/h3]

notes.title: Tower Princess participates in Steam Festival with an exclusive Demo!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow paladins![/h1]

We’re happy to announce that this week (!) We’re participating in a [b]Knight Tournament[/b] called[b] Steam Game Festival[/b] for some reason. This event starts on February 3rd at 10 am Pacific, till February 9th, make sure not to miss it!

[previewyoutube=Ql8yhNMZPnM;full][/previewyoutube]

And for this event we’ve updated our demo:
[list]
[*] With a new content
[*] Bug fixing
[*] A tutorial [/list]
And a dozen of small fixes:)

So if you're new around here, we’d be very happy if you give this demo a try, and if you did play it earlier, there is still some room for you to explore.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138650/Tower_Princess/

The team has a few surprises for you! 
First of all, they almost have a new boss developed, [b]Flavienn le Pigomancer[/b]! It may be small, but it’s the fastest boss on Tower Princess, so don’t underestimate him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/e10884b9af32cb3679dab9c6ff987edbaa35221b.gif[/img]

If you want to know a bit more about the other Dragon’s guardian, [b]DASHROOM[/b], get ready to test your skills against it in the Steam Game’s Festival demo!

On the other hand, the dungeon challenges are not only about bosses. The castle is full of monsters and battles, but right now the team is creating more platforming levels, with some crazy designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/a1e89865bb5ffb18d4f4619c614e6b072d1ef8ae.gif[/img]

Hope we see ya at Steam Festival! Follow us on social media:

https://twitter.com/AweKteaM
https://discord.gg/FKhYBDFwG2
